title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the Council’s recommendation on smoke- and aerosol-free environments
part_text: 6.Calls on the Member States to accordingly evaluate the recommendations to extend – as appropriate – public bans on smoking to new and emerging products emitting smoke or aerosols, such as heated tobacco products, e-cigarettes and other aerosol-emitting products, by applying a science-based approach and after considering evidence of the risks posed to non-smokers and non-users as a result of exposure to smoke and aerosols;
